purpose: Settle whether the fused path this task's public cases expect actually answers them, before any baseline is measured
route_resolution: the route is read from the aten op the dispatcher actually runs, not from a successful high-level call; it stays unverified when profiling is unavailable
note: Every case here is causal and half precision, which is what this task grades. The public smoke cases are B=1 H=4 S=64 D=32, B=2 H=8 S=128 D=32 and B=2 H=6 S=129 D=32; the rest are boundary variants of them that the hidden set is expected to draw from, so the probe covers the shape neighbourhood rather than only the three published points.
